title: Once MettleUp Plus limits are on, a free member can still see a 12-month or all-time exercise chart
what: The free part of MettleUp Plus is meant to show only 3 months of an exercise chart, and picking a longer range opens the Plus page. But when the chart first opens and the member has no workout of that exercise in the last 3 months, it opens straight on 12 months or All time with no check. A free member who has not done a lift lately sees its long history without paying. Today this does nothing, because the limits are switched off at launch.
expected: The chart's first range follows the same free-part rule as the range buttons: a free member opens on at most 3 months, with the line saying older workouts are part of Plus.
who: members on the free part of MettleUp Plus (none until the limits are switched on)
how_often: each time a free member opens the chart of a lift not done in the last 3 months
fix_line: Check the opening range against the free limit too, and fall back to 3 months for a free member

items.reason: none of these screens sends text to an AI: no AI call, prompt or model in the files; muscle tips and weight suggestions are worked out by fixed rules on the phone
